rationale: Ula is bringing embodied AI robotics to market as Aora Mind's founding GTM & Ops lead, while Kartik is a Founding Engineer at Brainbase Labs with deep hardware-software integration experience from leading AI teams at Samsung SRIB. Kartik's ML infrastructure and computer vision expertise could directly strengthen Aora Mind's path to production, and Ula's go-to-market perspective could inform how Brainbase structures its AI infrastructure products for real-world deployment.
intro_message: Ula LI, meet KARTIK PANDEY — you're both building AI systems that need to work in the real world, and his hardware-software integration background from Samsung paired with your GTM expertise could unlock something interesting.
